nodes.rationale: Same-origin proxy to bypass browser CORS restrictions; Docker or local dev forwards requests to real API

nodes.label: Custom Provider Manifest
nodes.rationale: JSON schema describing how to map third-party image API endpoints into the app's provider system; includes submit, editSubmit, poll, and result field path mappings

nodes.label: Codex CLI Compatibility Mode
nodes.rationale: Adapts parameters to what Codex CLI actually supports; splits multi-image generation into concurrent single-image requests; also enables prompt-rewrite prevention for Images API

nodes.label: Mock Image API Service
nodes.rationale: Local fault-simulation service reproducing browser-side image API anomalies: CORS blocks, malformed responses, timeouts, HTTP errors, redirects

nodes.label: Image Gallery & History Management
nodes.rationale: Waterfall and gallery views with full-screen preview, batch selection (mouse drag, Ctrl/Cmd, mobile swipe), batch favorites and cleanup, ZIP export backup
